items.source:
VertexAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails represents the details of a connection to the Vertex
AI embedding service. It provides methods to access the project ID, location,
publisher, and PredictionServiceSettings.
items.translation: VertexAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails 表示与 Vertex AI 嵌入服务的连接详情。它提供了访问项目 ID、位置、发布者和 PredictionServiceSettings 的方法。

items.source: Christian Tzolov, Mark Pollack, Ilayaperumal Gopinathan
